item.label: Icon Color
item.description: Here you can define a custom color for your icon.

item.label: Button Text
item.description: Input your desired button text, or leave blank for no button.

item.label: Reverse the tilt direction
item.description: Setting this option will reverse the tilt.

item.label: Transform perspective
item.description: Transform perspective, the lower the more extreme the tilt gets.

item.label: Glare
item.description: Setting this option will enable a glare effect.

item.label: Full page listening
item.description: Setting this option will make the element respond to any mouse movements on page.
